**Table 2 (p. 9) — cultivation modes of the 27 engineered‑strain entries:**

| Mode | Number of entries |
|---|---|

**Fed‑batch (15):** acetoin H32→H32‑nox (75,200 mg L⁻¹); acetoin G12→G12M (47,500); (2R,3R)‑2,3‑BD MG1→ΔslaC‑bdhA (89,810); (2R,3R)‑2,3‑BD HBQA7→SN1 (36,600); geraniol HM17 (2976); geraniol ΔslaC‑pyc (25,120); α‑pinene sPiM7 (32,500); (S)‑limonene LSF6 (22,800); S‑(+)‑linalool LISF06 (27,200); 1,8‑cineole HBQA7* (10,200); (E)‑nerolidol LN62 (70,500); β‑caryophyllene SMC18 (60,320); (−)‑α‑bisabolol LMB12 (30,200); (−)‑α‑bisabolol SMB19 (102,300); spermidine SPD16 (5800) — all p. 9.

**Shake flask (10):** the five prodigiosin entries (SK4‑72 15,630; SMCH 5830; JNB5‑1/NFPNFDB 8650; PG‑6 10,250; R82 11,400); (3R)‑acetoin MG15 (39,910); isoprenol IS‑2 (1410); isoprene IS‑8 (780); geraniol Sm29 (574); (−)‑α‑bisabolol Sm30 (1256) — p. 9.

**Whole‑cell biocatalyst (2):** acetoin MG1ABC (44,900) and 2,3‑butanediol MG1ABC (27,950), both 6 h — p. 9.

So fed‑batch entries outnumber shake‑flask entries by 15 to 10 (a 1.5:1 ratio), and they also account for the highest titers listed, including the record 102.3 g L⁻¹ (−)‑α‑bisabolol achieved in a 50‑L bioreactor (p. 11), whereas the best shake‑flask titer in the table is 39.91 g L⁻¹ (3R)‑acetoin (p. 9). Fed‑batch runs are also the longer ones (36–120 h) versus 36–108 h for shake flasks (p. 9).
